name: Super Blend - Nutrition Powder with Flavour Shots - 500g
subtitle: Complete Nutrition | Clinically tested on Indian Men.
metaDescription: Buy Man Matters Super Blend. Enriched with 25 gm Protein, 27 Vitamins & Minerals, Pro & Prebiotic Blend, Herbal Blend, Omega3 Fatty Acids; Third Party Lab Tested
howToUse: Mix 1 scoop (33g) Superblend Base in 200ml water.Add one flavour shot of your choice (Chocolate, Coffee, Mango, Strawberry, Kulfi Badam). Stir and sip.

faqs.question: What makes Superblend complete nutrition?
faqs.answer: It combines protein, vitamins, minerals, probiotics, and antioxidants in one scoop with flavour shots for taste

faqs.question: How does it help with energy?
faqs.answer: B-Vitamins and Magnesium support metabolism and reduce fatigue — helping you power through the day.

faqs.question: How does it help recovery?
faqs.answer: 25g of Whey Protein Isolate + Concentrate aids muscle repair and recovery after workouts.

faqs.question: How does it help gut health?
faqs.answer: 5Bn CFU Probiotics + Chicory Root Prebiotics promote smoother digestion and better nutrient absorption.

faqs.question: Is it safe for daily use?
faqs.answer: Yes. It’s clean, lab-tested, and free of preservatives, sugar, and harmful additives.
